description:
Full detail for a single player: market value, overall and positional rank, tier, age, and the players closest to them in value.

USE WHEN: the user asks what one player is worth, or wants realistic trade targets at a comparable price.
The comparables list is the practical answer to 'what could I get for him' — players inside the even band trade roughly one-for-one.

format.description: Value set to use. Default 'dynasty'. IMPORTANT: there is exactly ONE dynasty table and its QB values are superflex/market-weighted — dynasty values are not split by 1QB vs superflex or by scoring. The redraft sets ARE split: redraft-{sf,1qb}-{ppr,half,std}.

name: tradegauge_get_player_value
title: Get one player's value and trade comparables
